categories.main_business_segments: Assure Tech (Hangzhou) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the in vitro diagnostics (IVD) industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of point-of-care testing (POCT) reagents and instruments. Its product portfolio covers eight major areas including drug abuse detection, infectious disease detection, chronic disease detection, pregnancy testing, tumor markers, cardiac markers, biochemical testing, and allergen detection. The company also explores pet health diagnostics, home health management, and third-party medical laboratory services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages multiple advanced technology platforms including immunochromatography (colloidal gold and fluorescent immunoassay), dry chemistry, chemiluminescence, precision detection (molecular diagnostics and mass spectrometry), microfluidics, liquid biochips, clinical testing instruments, and biopharmaceuticals. It emphasizes self-supply of core biological raw materials such as recombinant antigens and monoclonal antibodies, supporting a vertically integrated production from raw materials to reagents and instruments. Production follows a make-to-order model with multi-variety, small-batch manufacturing, supported by intelligent manufacturing and SAP software.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers include international and domestic medical institutions, public security drug testing systems, pharmacies, hospitals, and end-users in home health and pet health markets. Its products are sold in over 150 countries including the US, Germany, UK, Canada, Russia, Mexico, Thailand, Indonesia, and Poland. The company serves both clinical and non-clinical markets, including third-party medical laboratories and veterinary diagnostics.
categories.geographic_coverage: Assure Tech operates globally with a strong presence in North America, Europe, Asia, Oceania, and Africa. It has established subsidiaries and sales offices in the US, Singapore, Hong Kong, and major Chinese cities such as Beijing, Shenzhen, Nanjing, Chengdu, Changsha, and Xi'an. The company maintains a dual domestic and international marketing network, with over 90% of revenue derived from overseas sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the upstream and midstream segments of the IVD supply chain. It produces core biological raw materials (antigens, antibodies), manufactures diagnostic reagents and instruments, and provides integrated solutions. It is moving towards full vertical integration to reduce reliance on imports and enhance supply chain control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on technological innovation and expanding its product portfolio in POCT and molecular diagnostics. It invests heavily in R&D across nine technology platforms, including immunochromatography, dry chemistry, chemiluminescence, precision detection, microfluidics, liquid biochips, and biopharmaceuticals. The company aims to industrialize emerging technologies, increase biological raw material self-sufficiency, and develop new products for human and pet health markets. It also pursues global marketing expansion and intelligent manufacturing upgrades.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of POCT reagents and diagnostic instruments under both ODM and OBM models. The company sells products directly to medical institutions, distributors, and end-users globally. It also derives income from government subsidies and investment returns. The sales model combines online and offline channels, including e-commerce platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Assure Tech is positioned as one of the few Chinese IVD companies capable of competing with multinational giants in the international POCT market. It holds a competitive edge through its vertically integrated supply chain, extensive product lines, and strong R&D capabilities. The company faces competition from global IVD leaders but benefits from growing domestic demand and policies favoring localization and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 503 million, a 91.84% decline from the previous year due to the end of the global respiratory infectious disease pandemic impacting demand. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 141.55 million, down 95.35%. Total assets were RMB 5.79 billion, with equity of RMB 5.11 billion. Despite the revenue decline, the company maintains a solid asset base and continues investing in R&D, with a 20.91% R&D-to-revenue ratio in 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Assure Tech emphasizes its comprehensive technology platforms and vertical integration from raw materials to finished products, ensuring high-quality, stable, and innovative POCT solutions. Its products cover a broad spectrum of diagnostic fields with rapid, accurate, and user-friendly testing capabilities. The company differentiates itself through proprietary biological raw materials, advanced immunoassay technologies, and a global marketing network, aiming to provide superior diagnostic products and services that meet diverse clinical and home-use needs.
